description: Small original factual seed, not a Wowhead mirror or exhaustive corpus. Current character state and source retrieval remain necessary.

entries.title: Forever is its own version
entries.text: Forever is Blizzard's permanent branch alongside Modern and Classic, built around an expanded original Azeroth and level-60 progression.

entries.title: Early Azeroth timeline
entries.text: Forever starts in the early original-world period, before the Dark Portal's reopening and later Northrend journeys. Later-expansion lore is not automatically current Forever lore.

entries.title: Changed leveling world
entries.text: The 1–60 world adds more than 1,000 quests and nine new five-player dungeons spanning levels 13–60. Old Classic routes and database facts need Forever verification.

entries.title: Profession choices
entries.text: Characters can learn two primary professions and all three secondary professions: Cooking, Fishing and First Aid.

entries.title: Camp profession features
entries.text: Initial profession camp features become available at skill 20 through starter quests or trainers. Advanced features requiring skill 140 or more come from dungeon and raid drops.

entries.title: Forever recipe differences
entries.text: Forever adds over 600 profession recipes, adjusted crafted food and advanced Blueprints from dungeon bosses.

entries.title: Healing potion crafting
entries.text: Wowhead's Forever profession overview, updated November 7, 2026 for Patch 1.60.1, places healing-potion crafting in First Aid. Do not reuse an Era Alchemy recipe list without checking.

entries.title: Drop percentages are observations
entries.text: Wowhead builds loot statistics from aggregated player observations. A cited drop percentage is an estimate, not a guaranteed number of kills. No exact Forever drop rates are included in this seed.

entries.title: Forever lookup tools
entries.text: Wowhead offers dedicated Forever quest-unstuck and profession-leveling tools. Opening these links does not mean this assistant has access to their interactive character data.

retrievalRules: Use Forever sources and qualify outdated or cross-version evidence.
Treat missing quest telemetry as unknown rather than proof of completion.
Do not invent drop rates, availability, route speed or profession material totals.
Do not bulk scrape or claim an exhaustive Wowhead corpus.
Cite retrieved URLs and preserve uncertainty when source content is unavailable.
